319	__device__ __forceinline__ float mb_block_sum(float v, float* red) {
320	    const unsigned full = 0xffffffffu;
321	    #pragma unroll
322	    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) v += __shfl_down_sync(full, v, o);
323	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31, warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
324	    if (lane == 0) red[warp] = v;
325	    __syncthreads();
326	    const int nwarp = (blockDim.x + 31) >> 5;
327	    if (warp == 0) {
328	        float p = (lane < nwarp) ? red[lane] : 0.0f;
329	        #pragma unroll
330	        for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) p += __shfl_down_sync(full, p, o);
331	        if (lane == 0) red[0] = p;
332	    }
333	    __syncthreads();
334	    float r = red[0];
335	    __syncthreads();
336	    return r;
337	}

343	    if (lane == 0) red[warp] = v;

358	// ── Primitive linear op (CTA-cooperative). y[s,:out] = x[s,:in] @ W[out,in]^T
359	//    (+ b). One thread per (s,o), strided. `ldX`/`ldY` are the row strides (in
360	//    elements) of x/y (so a packed view into a wider buffer works). ───────────
361	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_linear(
362	        const float* __restrict__ x, int in_dim, int ldX,
363	        const float* __restrict__ W, const float* __restrict__ b, int out_dim,
364	        float* __restrict__ y, int ldY) {
365	    const int total = mb::kSeq * out_dim;
366	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
367	        const int s = idx / out_dim, o = idx % out_dim;
368	        const float* xr = x + (int64_t)s * ldX;
369	        const float* Wr = W + (int64_t)o * in_dim;
370	        float acc = (b != nullptr) ? b[o] : 0.0f;
371	        #pragma unroll 4
372	        for (int k = 0; k < in_dim; ++k) acc += xr[k] * Wr[k];
373	        y[(int64_t)s * ldY + o] = acc;
374	    }
375	    __syncthreads();
376	}

378	// ── RMSNorm forward over the last dim (width=D). y = x*rsqrt(mean(x^2)+eps)*w.
379	//    Caches xhat = x*r and r (per row). NO mean-subtract, NO bias (RMS, not LN).
380	//    ldX = explicit row stride of x. xhat_out/y packed D-wide. (mamba3_oracle
381	//    rmsnorm_forward.) `width` so it serves both kD (norms) and kStateC (BCNorm).
382	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_rmsnorm_fwd(
383	        const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ w,
384	        float* __restrict__ y, float* __restrict__ xhat_out,
385	        float* __restrict__ r_out, float* red, int width, int ldX) {
386	    for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) {
387	        const float* xr = x + (int64_t)s * ldX;
388	        float ss = 0.0f;
389	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) { float v = xr[j]; ss += v * v; }
390	        float ms = mb_block_sum(ss, red) / (float)width;
391	        float r = rsqrtf(ms + mb::kRmsEps);
392	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) r_out[s] = r;
393	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
394	            float xh = xr[j] * r;
395	            xhat_out[(int64_t)s * width + j] = xh;
396	            y[(int64_t)s * width + j] = xh * w[j];
397	        }
398	        __syncthreads();
399	    }
400	}

402	// ── RMSNorm backward (mamba3_oracle rmsnorm_backward):
403	//     dw   = sum_rows (dy * xhat)
404	//     dxhat= dy * w
405	//     dx   = r * (dxhat - xhat * (sum_lastdim(dxhat*xhat) / D))
406	//    dy packed width-wide; xhat packed width-wide; dx_out packed width-wide.
407	//    gw is ACCUMULATED (+=). ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
408	__device__ inline void mb_rmsnorm_bwd(
409	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ xhat,
410	        const float* __restrict__ r, const float* __restrict__ w,
411	        float* __restrict__ dx_out, float* __restrict__ gw, float* red, int width) {
412	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
413	        float dgw = 0.0f;
414	        #pragma unroll
415	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s)
416	            dgw += dy[(int64_t)s * width + j] * xhat[(int64_t)s * width + j];
417	        gw[j] += dgw;
418	    }
419	    for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) {
420	        const float* dyr = dy + (int64_t)s * width;
421	        const float* xhr = xhat + (int64_t)s * width;
422	        float sdax = 0.0f;
423	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
424	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * w[j];
425	            sdax += dxhat * xhr[j];
426	        }
427	        sdax = mb_block_sum(sdax, red);
428	        float corr = sdax / (float)width;
429	        float rs = r[s];
430	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
431	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * w[j];
432	            dx_out[(int64_t)s * width + j] = rs * (dxhat - xhr[j] * corr);
433	        }
434	        __syncthreads();
435	    }
436	}

438	// ── dW += dY^T @ X for a linear Y = X @ W^T (+ b). dX = dY @ W (set or add).
439	//    Owner-thread per (o,i) for dW; db[o]+=Σ_s dY. ldX/ldY are x/dY row strides.─
440	__device__ inline void mb_linear_bwd(
441	        const float* __restrict__ dY, int ldY, const float* __restrict__ X, int ldX,
442	        const float* __restrict__ W, int in_dim, int out_dim,
443	        float* __restrict__ dW, float* __restrict__ db,
444	        float* __restrict__ dx_out, int ldDx, bool set_dx) {
445	    const int wtot = out_dim * in_dim;
446	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < wtot; idx += blockDim.x) {
447	        const int o = idx / in_dim, i = idx % in_dim;
448	        float acc = 0.0f;
449	        #pragma unroll
450	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) acc += dY[(int64_t)s * ldY + o] * X[(int64_t)s * ldX + i];
451	        dW[(int64_t)o * in_dim + i] += acc;
452	    }
453	    if (db != nullptr) {
454	        for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < out_dim; o += blockDim.x) {
455	            float acc = 0.0f;
456	            #pragma unroll
457	            for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) acc += dY[(int64_t)s * ldY + o];
458	            db[o] += acc;
459	        }
460	    }
461	    const int xtot = mb::kSeq * in_dim;
462	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < xtot; idx += blockDim.x) {
463	        const int s = idx / in_dim, i = idx % in_dim;
464	        float acc = 0.0f;
465	        for (int o = 0; o < out_dim; ++o) acc += dY[(int64_t)s * ldY + o] * W[(int64_t)o * in_dim + i];
466	        if (set_dx) dx_out[(int64_t)s * ldDx + i] = acc;
467	        else dx_out[(int64_t)s * ldDx + i] += acc;
468	    }
469	    __syncthreads();
470	}

472	// ── RMSNorm backward variant that recomputes xhat = x*r from the RAW pre-norm
473	//    input x (so callers that did NOT cache xhat — BCNorm, which caches only the
474	//    raw stream + recip — can reuse it). dx_out is written with row stride ldDx
475	//    (so it can land in a packed slice of a wider buffer). gw ACCUMULATED. ─────
476	__device__ inline void mb_rmsnorm_bwd_rawx(
477	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ x,
478	        const float* __restrict__ r, const float* __restrict__ w,
479	        float* __restrict__ dx_out, float* __restrict__ gw,
480	        float* red, int width, int ldDx) {
481	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
482	        float dgw = 0.0f;
483	        #pragma unroll
484	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s)
485	            dgw += dy[(int64_t)s * width + j] * (x[(int64_t)s * width + j] * r[s]);
486	        gw[j] += dgw;
487	    }
488	    for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) {
489	        const float* dyr = dy + (int64_t)s * width;
490	        const float* xr  = x  + (int64_t)s * width;
491	        float rs = r[s];
492	        float sdax = 0.0f;
493	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
494	            float xhat = xr[j] * rs;
495	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * w[j];
496	            sdax += dxhat * xhat;
497	        }
498	        sdax = mb_block_sum(sdax, red);
499	        float corr = sdax / (float)width;
500	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < width; j += blockDim.x) {
501	            float xhat = xr[j] * rs;
502	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * w[j];
503	            dx_out[(int64_t)s * ldDx + j] = rs * (dxhat - xhat * corr);
504	        }
505	        __syncthreads();
506	    }
507	}

509	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
510	//  COMPLEX EXPONENTIAL-TRAPEZOIDAL SELECTIVE SCAN — forward (Eq 25). One thread
511	//  owns SSM channel j in [0,d_inner). Its head is h = j/head_dim. Within the
512	//  head it holds the complex state h[Nc][2] in REGISTERS and unrolls t=0..kSeq-1.
513	//  Reads (from the LayerAct cache `a`): x_in[t][j], dt_pre[t][h] (per head),
514	//  A_mod[t][h], u_lam[t][h], theta[t][c], Bbar[t][c][:], Cbar[t][c][:], and
515	//  A_log[h]. Writes y_scan[t][j]. Mirrors mamba3_oracle.scan_forward.
516	//    alpha=exp(dt*A); A=-softplus(A_mod+exp(A_log)); dt=softplus(dt_pre);
517	//    lam=sigmoid(u_lam); gamma=lam*dt; beta=(1-lam)*dt*alpha; phi=dt*theta.
518	//    v_t = (Br2*x, Bi2*x);  h_t = alpha*R h_{t-1} + beta*R v_{t-1} + gamma*v_t;
519	//    y_t = sum_c (Cbar0*h0 + Cbar1*h1).
520	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
521	__device__ inline void mb_scan_fwd(const float* __restrict__ A_log,
522	                           const MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a,
523	                           float* __restrict__ y_scan_out) {
524	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kDInner; j += blockDim.x) {
525	        const int h = j / mb::kHeadDim;
526	        const float base_rate = __expf(A_log[h]);       // exp(A_log[h])
527	        // complex state (real,imag) per coord + previous v_t. NOTE: these per-coord
528	        // arrays (kStateC=64 each × 4) are RUNTIME-INDEXED local memory — the c-loop
529	        // is intentionally NOT #pragma unroll'd (full unroll would force 256 regs >
530	        // the 255 cap and the carried state across the t-loop would not persist; that
531	        // was the "t=0 right, t>0 wrong" bug). The t-loop (only kSeq=8) stays rolled.
532	        float hr[mb::kStateC], hi[mb::kStateC];
533	        float vpr[mb::kStateC], vpi[mb::kStateC];        // v_{t-1}
534	        for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) { hr[c]=0.f; hi[c]=0.f; vpr[c]=0.f; vpi[c]=0.f; }
535	        for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t) {
536	            const float xv = a->x_in[t][j];
537	            const float dt_t = mb_softplus(a->dt_pre[t][h]);
538	            const float A_t = -mb_softplus(a->A_mod[t][h] + base_rate);
539	            const float lam = mb_sigmoid(a->u_lam[t][h]);
540	            const float alpha = __expf(dt_t * A_t);
541	            const float gamma = lam * dt_t;
542	            const float beta = (1.0f - lam) * dt_t * alpha;
543	            float yacc = 0.0f;
544	            for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) {
545	                const float phi = dt_t * a->theta[t][c];
546	                float cs, sn; __sincosf(phi, &sn, &cs);
547	                // v_t = Bbar_t (.) x_t
548	                const float vr = a->Bbar[t][c][0] * xv;
549	                const float vi = a->Bbar[t][c][1] * xv;
550	                // R @ h_{t-1}
551	                const float Rhr = cs * hr[c] - sn * hi[c];
552	                const float Rhi = sn * hr[c] + cs * hi[c];
553	                // R @ v_{t-1}
554	                const float Rvr = cs * vpr[c] - sn * vpi[c];
555	                const float Rvi = sn * vpr[c] + cs * vpi[c];
556	                // h_t = alpha*Rh + beta*Rv + gamma*v_t
557	                const float nhr = alpha * Rhr + beta * Rvr + gamma * vr;
558	                const float nhi = alpha * Rhi + beta * Rvi + gamma * vi;
559	                hr[c] = nhr; hi[c] = nhi;
560	                vpr[c] = vr; vpi[c] = vi;
561	                // y_t += Cbar . h_t
562	                yacc += a->Cbar[t][c][0] * nhr + a->Cbar[t][c][1] * nhi;
563	            }
564	            y_scan_out[t * mb::kDInner + j] = yacc;
565	        }
566	    }
567	    __syncthreads();
568	}

570	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
571	//  COMPLEX SCAN backward (reverse time). Per channel j (one thread, head
572	//  h=j/head_dim): RECOMPUTE the forward keeping h_hist[kSeq+1] AND v_hist[kSeq+1]
573	//  (complex) in registers (seq=8 — NO checkpoint), then reverse-scan the
574	//  two-adjoint (gh,gv) recurrence (MAMBA3_REFERENCE.md sec 6.2).
575	//
576	//  PER-CHANNEL outputs (this thread owns channel j):
577	//    dx_in[t,j]  (the scan's contribution to x_in)
578	//    ddt_pre[t,h] (per head — accumulated across the head_dim channels via block
579	//                  reduce BY HEAD), dA_mod, du_lam (per head, same)
580	//  HEAD-SHARED outputs (reduced over ALL channels into smem):
581	//    dBbar[t,c,:], dCbar[t,c,:], dtheta[t,c]
582	//
583	//  The per-head dalpha/dbeta/dgamma/dphi are folded into ddt/dA_real/dlam/dtheta
584	//  via the sec 6.3 coefficient Jacobian. Because alpha/beta/gamma/phi are shared
585	//  by the head_dim channels of a head, the head-scalar grads are summed over the
586	//  channels in the head (block reduce restricted to the head's lanes), then the
587	//  owner of that head writes ddt_pre/dA_mod/du_lam.
588	//
589	//  dA_log[h] = sum_t dA_real[t,h] * (-sigmoid(A_arg)) * exp(A_log[h]); the
590	//  -softplus and exp(A_log) Jacobians fold here. (Accumulated into g_A_log.)
591	//
592	//  Determinism: the head-shared dBbar/dCbar/dtheta block-reduce per (t,c) in the
593	//  reverse loop (ascending lane/warp); the per-head coeff grads block-reduce per
594	//  (t,h). Same addends, fixed order -> A/A/A bit-identical.
595	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
596	__device__ inline void mb_scan_bwd(const float* __restrict__ A_log,
597	                           const MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a,
598	                           const float* __restrict__ dy_scan,     // [kSeq,d_inner]
599	                           float* __restrict__ dx_in,             // [kSeq,d_inner] SET
600	                           float* __restrict__ ddt_pre,           // [kSeq,n_heads] SET (per head)
601	                           float* __restrict__ dA_mod,            // [kSeq,n_heads] SET
602	                           float* __restrict__ du_lam,            // [kSeq,n_heads] SET
603	                           float* __restrict__ dBbar,             // [kSeq,Nc,2]  smem (+=, zeroed by caller)
604	                           float* __restrict__ dCbar,             // [kSeq,Nc,2]  smem
605	                           float* __restrict__ dtheta,            // [kSeq,Nc]    smem
606	                           float* __restrict__ g_A_log,           // [n_heads] partial (+=)
607	                           float* __restrict__ red) {
608	    const bool active = (threadIdx.x < mb::kDInner);
609	    const int j = threadIdx.x;
610	    const int h = active ? (j / mb::kHeadDim) : 0;
611	    const float base_rate = active ? __expf(A_log[h]) : 0.0f;
612	    // Per-(t) cached scalars (recomputed), per-channel forward state history.
613	    float dt_save[mb::kSeq], alpha_s[mb::kSeq], beta_s[mb::kSeq], gamma_s[mb::kSeq];
614	    float A_s[mb::kSeq], lam_s[mb::kSeq];
615	    // complex state history: hh[t] = h_{t-1} (hh[0]=0), v stored as vh[t]=v_t.
616	    float hhr[mb::kSeq + 1][mb::kStateC], hhi[mb::kSeq + 1][mb::kStateC];
617	    float vhr[mb::kSeq][mb::kStateC], vhi[mb::kSeq][mb::kStateC];
618	    if (active) {
619	        for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) { hhr[0][c]=0.f; hhi[0][c]=0.f; }
620	        for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t) {
621	            const float xv = a->x_in[t][j];
622	            const float dt_t = mb_softplus(a->dt_pre[t][h]);
623	            const float A_t = -mb_softplus(a->A_mod[t][h] + base_rate);
624	            const float lam = mb_sigmoid(a->u_lam[t][h]);
625	            const float alpha = __expf(dt_t * A_t);
626	            const float gamma = lam * dt_t;
627	            const float beta = (1.0f - lam) * dt_t * alpha;
628	            dt_save[t]=dt_t; A_s[t]=A_t; lam_s[t]=lam; alpha_s[t]=alpha; beta_s[t]=beta; gamma_s[t]=gamma;
629	            for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) {
630	                const float phi = dt_t * a->theta[t][c];
631	                float cs, sn; __sincosf(phi, &sn, &cs);
632	                const float vr = a->Bbar[t][c][0] * xv;
633	                const float vi = a->Bbar[t][c][1] * xv;
634	                const float prev_vr = (t > 0) ? vhr[t-1][c] : 0.0f;
635	                const float prev_vi = (t > 0) ? vhi[t-1][c] : 0.0f;
636	                const float Rhr = cs * hhr[t][c] - sn * hhi[t][c];
637	                const float Rhi = sn * hhr[t][c] + cs * hhi[t][c];
638	                const float Rvr = cs * prev_vr - sn * prev_vi;
639	                const float Rvi = sn * prev_vr + cs * prev_vi;
640	                hhr[t+1][c] = alpha_s[t] * Rhr + beta_s[t] * Rvr + gamma_s[t] * vr;
641	                hhi[t+1][c] = alpha_s[t] * Rhi + beta_s[t] * Rvi + gamma_s[t] * vi;
642	                vhr[t][c] = vr; vhi[t][c] = vi;
643	            }
644	        }
645	    }
646	    // reverse-time adjoints (per channel): gh = dL/dh_t, gv = dL/dv_t (from t+1).
647	    float ghr[mb::kStateC], ghi[mb::kStateC], gvr[mb::kStateC], gvi[mb::kStateC];
648	    if (active) {
649	        #pragma unroll
650	        for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) { ghr[c]=0.f; ghi[c]=0.f; gvr[c]=0.f; gvi[c]=0.f; }
651	    }
652	    // Per-head dA_log accumulation across t (this channel contributes via its head;
653	    // reduced by head). dA_log[h] += sum_t dA_real[t,h]*(-sigmoid(A_arg))*exp(A_log[h]).
654	    float dAlog_acc = 0.0f;   // this channel's running sum (folded per head at end)
655	    for (int t = mb::kSeq - 1; t >= 0; --t) {
656	        // This channel's per-(t,head) coefficient-grad contributions (summed over c).
657	        float dalpha = 0.f, dbeta = 0.f, dgamma = 0.f, dt_phi = 0.f;
658	        float dx_acc = 0.0f;
659	        const float xv = active ? a->x_in[t][j] : 0.0f;
660	        const float dt_t = active ? dt_save[t] : 0.0f;
661	        const float a_t = active ? alpha_s[t] : 0.0f;
662	        const float b_t = active ? beta_s[t] : 0.0f;
663	        const float g_t = active ? gamma_s[t] : 0.0f;
664	        const float dyv = active ? dy_scan[t * mb::kDInner + j] : 0.0f;
665	        for (int c = 0; c < mb::kStateC; ++c) {
666	            float dBbar0 = 0.f, dBbar1 = 0.f, dCbar0 = 0.f, dCbar1 = 0.f, dphi = 0.f;
667	            if (active) {
668	                const float phi = dt_t * a->theta[t][c];
669	                float cs, sn; __sincosf(phi, &sn, &cs);
670	                // (1) y_t = sum Cbar . h_t -> gh += Cbar * dy ; dCbar += h_t * dy
671	                const float h0 = hhr[t+1][c], h1 = hhi[t+1][c];
672	                dCbar0 = h0 * dyv; dCbar1 = h1 * dyv;
673	                ghr[c] += a->Cbar[t][c][0] * dyv;
674	                ghi[c] += a->Cbar[t][c][1] * dyv;          // gh now = full dL/dh_t
675	                // (2) v_t total grad = gv + gamma*gh ; v_t = Bbar*x
676	                const float dv0 = gvr[c] + g_t * ghr[c];
677	                const float dv1 = gvi[c] + g_t * ghi[c];
678	                dx_acc += dv0 * a->Bbar[t][c][0] + dv1 * a->Bbar[t][c][1];
679	                dBbar0 = dv0 * xv; dBbar1 = dv1 * xv;
680	                // (3) rotated terms Rh = R h_{t-1}, Rv = R v_{t-1}; coeff + phi grads
681	                const float hr_p = hhr[t][c], hi_p = hhi[t][c];
682	                const float vr_p = (t>0)? vhr[t-1][c]:0.0f, vi_p = (t>0)? vhi[t-1][c]:0.0f;
683	                const float Rh0 = cs * hr_p - sn * hi_p, Rh1 = sn * hr_p + cs * hi_p;
684	                const float Rv0 = cs * vr_p - sn * vi_p, Rv1 = sn * vr_p + cs * vi_p;
685	                dalpha += Rh0 * ghr[c] + Rh1 * ghi[c];
686	                dbeta  += Rv0 * ghr[c] + Rv1 * ghi[c];
687	                dgamma += vhr[t][c] * ghr[c] + vhi[t][c] * ghi[c];
688	                // dphi via R'(phi)=[[-sin,-cos],[cos,-sin]] on h_{t-1}(coef alpha) & v_{t-1}(coef beta)
689	                const float dRh = ghr[c]*(-sn*hr_p - cs*hi_p) + ghi[c]*(cs*hr_p - sn*hi_p);
690	                const float dRv = ghr[c]*(-sn*vr_p - cs*vi_p) + ghi[c]*(cs*vr_p - sn*vi_p);
691	                dphi = a_t * dRh + b_t * dRv;
692	                dt_phi += dphi * a->theta[t][c];           // dt-fold term (sum_c dphi*theta)
693	                // (4) propagate to prev step (R^T): R^T g = (cs*g0+sn*g1, -sn*g0+cs*g1)
694	                const float g0 = ghr[c], g1 = ghi[c];
695	                const float RTg0 = cs * g0 + sn * g1;
696	                const float RTg1 = -sn * g0 + cs * g1;
697	                gvr[c] = b_t * RTg0; gvi[c] = b_t * RTg1;   // dL/dv_{t-1}
698	                ghr[c] = a_t * RTg0; ghi[c] = a_t * RTg1;   // dL/dh_{t-1}
699	            }
700	            // head-shared reduces (per t,c): block-sum across ALL channels (ascending).
701	            float sB0 = mb_block_sum(dBbar0, red);
702	            float sB1 = mb_block_sum(dBbar1, red);
703	            float sC0 = mb_block_sum(dCbar0, red);
704	            float sC1 = mb_block_sum(dCbar1, red);
705	            float sTh = mb_block_sum(active ? (dphi * dt_t) : 0.0f, red);  // dtheta[t,c] += dphi*dt
706	            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
707	                dBbar[(t * mb::kStateC + c) * 2 + 0] += sB0;
708	                dBbar[(t * mb::kStateC + c) * 2 + 1] += sB1;
709	                dCbar[(t * mb::kStateC + c) * 2 + 0] += sC0;
710	                dCbar[(t * mb::kStateC + c) * 2 + 1] += sC1;
711	                dtheta[t * mb::kStateC + c] += sTh;
712	            }
713	        }
714	        if (active) dx_in[t * mb::kDInner + j] = dx_acc;
715	        // ── Fold the per-head coefficient Jacobians (sec 6.3) for step t. The
716	        //    head_dim channels of a head share alpha/beta/gamma/dt/A/lam, so sum
717	        //    each channel's dalpha/dbeta/dgamma/dt_phi over the head, then the owner
718	        //    writes the per-head ddt_pre/dA_mod/du_lam. Reduce-by-head via masked
719	        //    block sums (one per head, ascending) keeps it deterministic.
720	        //    ddt(post-softplus) = dalpha*(A*alpha) + dbeta*((1-lam)*alpha*(1+dt*A))
721	        //                       + dgamma*lam + dt_phi
722	        //    dlam = dbeta*(-dt*alpha) + dgamma*dt
723	        //    dA_real = dalpha*(dt*alpha) + dbeta*((1-lam)*dt^2*alpha)
724	        //    then ddt_pre = ddt*softplus'(dt_pre); dA_mod = dA_real*(-sigmoid(A_arg));
725	        //         du_lam = dlam*lam*(1-lam); dA_log fold uses dA_real*(-sig)*exp(A_log).
726	        const float A_t = active ? A_s[t] : 0.0f;
727	        const float lam = active ? lam_s[t] : 0.0f;
728	        float ddt_c = 0.f, dlam_c = 0.f, dAreal_c = 0.f;
729	        if (active) {
730	            ddt_c   = dalpha*(A_t*a_t) + dbeta*((1.0f-lam)*a_t*(1.0f+dt_t*A_t)) + dgamma*lam + dt_phi;
731	            dlam_c  = dbeta*(-dt_t*a_t) + dgamma*dt_t;
732	            dAreal_c= dalpha*(dt_t*a_t) + dbeta*((1.0f-lam)*dt_t*dt_t*a_t);
733	        }
734	        // Reduce the 3 head scalars over the channels of each head. Loop heads;
735	        // each head's lanes [h*head_dim, (h+1)*head_dim) contribute, owner = first lane.
736	        #pragma unroll
737	        for (int hh = 0; hh < mb::kNHeads; ++hh) {
738	            const bool mine = active && (h == hh);
739	            float sddt   = mb_block_sum(mine ? ddt_c   : 0.0f, red);
740	            float sdlam  = mb_block_sum(mine ? dlam_c  : 0.0f, red);
741	            float sdAr   = mb_block_sum(mine ? dAreal_c: 0.0f, red);
742	            if (threadIdx.x == 0) {
743	                // A_arg = A_mod + exp(A_log); A_real = -softplus(A_arg)
744	                // (read A_mod/dt_pre/u_lam at any lane — use the cached per-(t,h) values).
745	                const float dt_pre_h = a->dt_pre[t][hh];
746	                const float u_lam_h  = a->u_lam[t][hh];
747	                const float A_arg_h  = a->A_mod[t][hh] + __expf(A_log[hh]);
748	                ddt_pre[t * mb::kNHeads + hh] = sddt * mb_softplus_grad(dt_pre_h);
749	                du_lam [t * mb::kNHeads + hh] = sdlam * mb_sigmoid_grad(u_lam_h);
750	                dA_mod [t * mb::kNHeads + hh] = sdAr * (-mb_softplus_grad(A_arg_h));
751	            }
752	            __syncthreads();
753	        }
754	        // dA_log[h] += sum_t dA_real[t,h]*(-sigmoid(A_arg))*exp(A_log[h]). Fold the
755	        // per-channel dAreal here (same channel-in-head contribution).
756	        if (active) {
757	            const float A_arg = a->A_mod[t][h] + base_rate;
758	            dAlog_acc += dAreal_c * (-mb_sigmoid(A_arg)) * base_rate;

100	// 20-tensor block (li) starts at flat tidx 2+20*li; the 7 2D weights are at
101	// block-offsets {7,8,9,15,17,18,19} = in_proj,x_proj,dt_proj_w,out_proj,gate,up,down.
102	// Dense order:
103	//   mi=0 tok[V,d]; mi=1 pos[seq,d];
104	//   mi∈[2,2+7L): li=(mi-2)/7, kind=(mi-2)%7 →
105	//     kind0 in_proj  tidx 2 +20li+7  [2*d_inner, d]
106	//     kind1 x_proj   tidx 2 +20li+8  [x_proj_out, d_inner]
107	//     kind2 dt_proj  tidx 2 +20li+9  [n_heads, dt_rank]
108	//     kind3 out_proj tidx 2 +20li+15 [d, d_inner]
109	//     kind4 gate     tidx 2 +20li+17 [d_ff, d]
110	//     kind5 up       tidx 2 +20li+18 [d_ff, d]
111	//     kind6 down     tidx 2 +20li+19 [d, d_ff]
112	//   mi=2+7L head out.weight tidx 2+20*L+1 [phead, d].
113	// At L=2 reproduces the old kMbMuon2D[17] EXACTLY (tidx {0,1,9,10,11,17,19,20,21,
114	// 29,30,31,37,39,40,41,43}).
115	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ MbMuon2D mb_muon_2d(int mi) {
116	    if (mi == 0)                       return { 0, mb::kVocab, mb::kD };   // tok
117	    if (mi == 1)                       return { 1, mb::kSeq,   mb::kD };   // pos
118	    if (mi == 2 + 7 * mb::kLayers)     return { 2 + 20 * mb::kLayers + 1, mb::kPHead, mb::kD }; // head.out
119	    const int li   = (mi - 2) / 7;
120	    const int kind = (mi - 2) % 7;
121	    const int base = 2 + 20 * li;
122	    if (kind == 0) return { base + 7,  2 * mb::kDInner, mb::kD       };  // in_proj
123	    if (kind == 1) return { base + 8,  mb::kXProj,      mb::kDInner  };  // x_proj
124	    if (kind == 2) return { base + 9,  mb::kNHeads,     mb::kDtRank  };  // dt_proj
125	    if (kind == 3) return { base + 15, mb::kD,          mb::kDInner  };  // out_proj
126	    if (kind == 4) return { base + 17, mb::kDff,        mb::kD       };  // gate
127	    if (kind == 5) return { base + 18, mb::kDff,        mb::kD       };  // up
128	    return            { base + 19, mb::kD,          mb::kDff     };      // down
129	}

139	        return (r == 7 || r == 8 || r == 9 || r == 15 || r == 17 || r == 18 || r == 19);

159	//  MAMBA-3 TENSOR-PARALLEL (Megatron) SHARD — the analogue of the decoder's
160	//  kDecTpShard / tp_layer.cuh geometry, scoped to the SCALAR Mamba path.
161	//
162	//  WHY A NEW TABLE (NOT a reuse of tp_layer.cuh): tp_layer.cuh's partial-GEMM
163	//  helpers are built on the decoder wgmma tile engine (dectc::dectc_gemm_*,
164	//  dec:: dims) — they do NOT apply to the scan-dominated scalar Mamba path,
165	//  which projects with the per-(s,o)-owner-computes mb_linear, not wgmma tiles.
166	//  So the Mamba TP reuses ONLY the transport-agnostic primitives from
167	//  tp_transport.cuh (LoopbackTransport/NvshmemTransport, the fixed-order
168	//  ascending-pe reduce, make_transport_from_comm) + parallel_config.cuh
169	//  (ParConfig/CommCtx). The sharded partial here is a SCALAR row-parallel
170	//  mb_linear writing fp32 directly into the symmetric slot.
171	//
172	//  THE MEGATRON SPLIT ON MAMBA'S 45-TENSOR LAYOUT (row-major [Nout,Kin],
173	//  named_parameters() order; per-layer 20-block at flat 2+20*li; block-offsets
174	//  r∈{7=in_proj,8=x_proj,9=dt_proj_w,15=out_proj,17=gate,18=up,19=down}):
175	//
176	//   weight (block r)     split          rank owns                    comm
177	//   ------------------------------------------------------------------------
178	//   in_proj  (7)         COLUMN         rows [r·2di/P,(r+1)·2di/P)    none (fwd)
179	//   out_proj (15)        ROW            cols [r·di/P,(r+1)·di/P)      fwd all-reduce ①
180	//   gate     (17)        COLUMN         rows [r·dff/P,(r+1)·dff/P)    none (fwd)
181	//   up       (18)        COLUMN         same rows                     none
182	//   down     (19)        ROW            cols [r·dff/P,(r+1)·dff/P)    fwd all-reduce ②
183	//   x_proj/dt_proj/scan internals + B/C norms + biases + D + A_log + the
184	//   RMSNorms + tok/pos/head + norm           REPLICATED               none
185	//
186	//  SCOPING NOTE (the Mamba-specific honest boundary — analogue of the decoder's
187	//  "attention head-shard is the one model-specific touch"): the decoder TP
188	//  localizes attention to H/P heads on the column-parallel in_proj path. Mamba
189	//  has NO standard attention, so that touch is precisely SCOPED OUT. The Mamba
190	//  SSM (x_proj→dt/A/lam/theta/B/C→selective scan) consumes the FULL d_inner
191	//  x_main with HEAD-SHARED (theta/B/C over Nc) and per-head (dt/A/lam) terms
192	//  that do NOT decompose into independent per-rank channel shards the way the
193	//  decoder's per-head attention does (theta/B/C are shared across heads). So
194	//  the Mamba TP shards the PROJECTION recombination boundaries (the row-parallel
195	//  out_proj/down all-reduces + their column-parallel dX conjugates) — exactly
196	//  the decoder's 4 reduce points minus the head localization — and keeps the
197	//  SSM math replicated. A full head-sharded selective scan (n_heads/P per rank,
198	//  head-local theta/B/C) is the documented deep follow-up, NOT this mechanical
199	//  mirror. The 4 reduce points below are the faithful, loopback-checkable core.
200	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
201	enum class MbTpSplit : int8_t {
202	    Replicated = 0,   // full tensor on every rank (grads bit-identical, no comm)
203	    Col        = 1,   // split along Nout (output rows) — column-parallel
204	    Row        = 2,   // split along Kin  (input cols)  — row-parallel (+ all-reduce)
205	};
206	struct MbTpTensorShard { int tidx; MbTpSplit split; };

208	// The 45-tensor Mamba shard table (mb_bind named order). Per-layer 20-block at
209	// flat 2+20*li; only {in_proj(+7)=Col, out_proj(+15)=Row, gate(+17)=Col,
210	// up(+18)=Col, down(+19)=Row} are sharded; everything else replicated.
211	__device__ __forceinline__ MbTpSplit mb_tp_split_of(int t) {
212	    if (t < 2) return MbTpSplit::Replicated;                       // tok, pos
213	    if (t >= 2 + 20 * mb::kLayers) return MbTpSplit::Replicated;   // norm, head w/b
214	    const int r = (t - 2) % 20;
215	    if (r == 7)  return MbTpSplit::Col;   // in_proj  [2*d_inner, d]
216	    if (r == 15) return MbTpSplit::Row;   // out_proj [d, d_inner]
217	    if (r == 17) return MbTpSplit::Col;   // gate     [d_ff, d]
218	    if (r == 18) return MbTpSplit::Col;   // up       [d_ff, d]
219	    if (r == 19) return MbTpSplit::Row;   // down     [d, d_ff]
220	    return MbTpSplit::Replicated;
221	}

230	// ── SCALAR row-parallel forward partial (the Mamba analogue of
231	//    tp_rowparallel_fwd_partial_tile, but owner-computes not wgmma). Each PE
232	//    computes Ypart[s, o] = Σ_{k in own col-shard} Xown[s,k]·Wshard[o,k] over
233	//    its [Nout, Kin/P] dense col-shard and writes the fp32 partial DIRECTLY into
234	//    this PE's symmetric slot (the publish). Caller then rendezvous + fixed-order
235	//    ascending-pe reduce → the full Σ_pe Ypart (all-reduce point ①/②). No bias
236	//    here — the replicated bias is added by the caller AFTER the reduce (matching
237	//    the decoder: out_b/ff2_b are post-reduce adds). ──
238	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_tp_rowparallel_fwd_partial(
239	        float* __restrict__ slot,                 // tr.local(slot_off): [kSeq*Nout] fp32
240	        const float* __restrict__ Xown, int ldX,  // [kSeq, Kin_local] (rank's own input shard)
241	        const float* __restrict__ Wshard,         // [Nout, Kin_local] dense row-major col-shard
242	        int Kin_local, int Nout) {
243	    const int total = mb::kSeq * Nout;
244	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
245	        const int s = idx / Nout, o = idx % Nout;
246	        const float* xr = Xown + (int64_t)s * ldX;
247	        const float* Wr = Wshard + (int64_t)o * Kin_local;
248	        float acc = 0.0f;
249	        #pragma unroll 4
250	        for (int k = 0; k < Kin_local; ++k) acc += xr[k] * Wr[k];
251	        slot[(int64_t)s * Nout + o] = acc;
252	    }
253	    __syncthreads();
254	}

257	//    dXpart[s,i] = Σ_{o in own row-shard} dYown[s,o]·Wshard[o,i], the rank's
258	//    contribution to the FULL [kSeq, Kin] dX; published to the symmetric slot,
259	//    caller rendezvous + reduce ⇒ dX = Σ_pe dXpart. Wshard is the rank's
260	//    [Nout_local, Kin] dense row-shard. ──
261	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_tp_colparallel_dx_partial(
262	        float* __restrict__ slot,                 // tr.local(slot_off): [kSeq*Kin] fp32
263	        const float* __restrict__ dYown, int ldY, // [kSeq, Nout_local]
264	        const float* __restrict__ Wshard,         // [Nout_local, Kin] dense row-major row-shard
265	        int Kin, int Nout_local) {
266	    const int total = mb::kSeq * Kin;
267	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
268	        const int s = idx / Kin, i = idx % Kin;
269	        const float* dyr = dYown + (int64_t)s * ldY;
270	        float acc = 0.0f;
271	        for (int o = 0; o < Nout_local; ++o) acc += dyr[o] * Wshard[(int64_t)o * Kin + i];
272	        slot[(int64_t)s * Kin + i] = acc;
273	    }
274	    __syncthreads();
275	}

335	// Forward: SingleGPU forwards verbatim (byte-identical). kTPComm runs the mixer

337	template <class Par = ::sg::fused::par::SingleGPU,
338	          class Transport = ::sg::fused::sm90::tp::LoopbackTransport>
339	__device__ inline float mb_forward_sample_tp(
340	        const MambaWeights& w, const int* tokens_s, int target, bool active,
341	        MambaSampleSmem* sm, const Transport& tr, const ::sg::fused::GridBarrier& bar,
342	        int64_t slot_pub, int64_t slot_red) {
343	    if constexpr (!Par::kTPComm) {
344	        (void)active; (void)tr; (void)bar; (void)slot_pub; (void)slot_red;
345	        return mb_forward_sample(w, tokens_s, target, sm);
346	    } else {
347	        // ── kTPComm forward. The SSM body is replicated (unsharded mb_* device
348	        //    fns); the two ROW-parallel projections (mixer out_proj, swiglu down)
349	        //    publish a partial → rendezvous → fixed-order reduce. The replicated
350	        //    bias is folded post-reduce. The recombination is the decoder ①/② set.
351	        const int P = tr.n_pes();
352	        float nll_acc = 0.0f;
353	        // Embedding + positional -> layer_in[0] (replicated, only when active).
354	        if (active) {
355	            for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
356	                const int s = idx / mb::kD, j = idx % mb::kD;
357	                sm->layer_in[0][s][j] = w.tok[(int64_t)tokens_s[s] * mb::kD + j]
358	                                      + w.pos[(int64_t)s * mb::kD + j];
359	            }
360	            __syncthreads();
361	        }
362	        for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li) {
363	            const MambaWeights::Layer& L = w.layer[li];
364	            MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a = &sm->act[li];
365	            float* hin = &sm->layer_in[li][0][0];
366	            // --- mixer sub-block (SSM replicated; out_proj ROW-parallel reduce ①) ---
367	            if (active) {
368	                mb_rmsnorm_fwd(hin, L.mixn_w, &sm->dr[0][0], &sm->adj_c[0][0], &a->mixn_r[0],
369	                               sm->red, mb::kD, mb::kD);   // xn -> sm->dr
370	                // mixer through y_gated (everything before out_proj); y_gated -> sm->adj_a.
371	                mb_mixer_fwd_pre_outproj(L, &sm->dr[0][0], a, sm);
372	            }
373	            // out_proj ROW-parallel: out_w is the rank's [d, d_inner/P] col-shard;
374	            // y_gated (sm->adj_a) is the rank's own [kSeq, d_inner/P]. Publish [kSeq,d]
375	            // partial -> reduce -> mix_out (sm->adj_b, kD-strided). (① of the shard table.)
376	            const int Kloc = mb::kDInner / P;
377	            if (active) {
378	                mbtc::mb_tp_rowparallel_fwd_partial(
379	                    tr.local(slot_pub), &sm->adj_a[0][0], mb::kDInner, L.out_w, Kloc, mb::kD);
380	            }
381	            tr.rendezvous(bar);
382	            ::sg::fused::sm90::tp::tp_allreduce_sum_fixed_order(
383	                tr, slot_pub, &sm->adj_b[0][0], (int64_t)mb::kSeq * mb::kD, threadIdx.x, blockDim.x);
384	            tr.rendezvous(bar);
385	            if (active) {
386	                float* mo = &sm->adj_b[0][0];
387	                for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
388	                    const int s = idx / mb::kD, j = idx % mb::kD;
389	                    a->h1[s][j] = hin[s * mb::kD + j] + mo[s * mb::kD + j];   // h1 = x + mixer_out
390	                }
391	                __syncthreads();
392	                // --- SwiGLU sub-block (gate/up COLUMN replicated; down ROW reduce ②) ---
393	                mb_rmsnorm_fwd(&a->h1[0][0], L.mlpn_w, &sm->dr[0][0], &sm->adj_c[0][0], &a->mlpn_r[0],
